title: Mosasaurs Were Capable of Explosive Speed - Nautilus
author: Jake Currie
text: Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisementPaleontologyMosasaurs Were Capable of Explosive SpeedAs if they weren’t terrifying enoughJCBy Jake Currie11:00 AM CDT on October 9, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleThe Cretaceous oceans were as dangerous as they were vast. Even the fearsome plesiosaurs lived in terror of larger predators, like mosasaurs. The largest of these massive aquatic reptiles could grow as big as 56-feet-long, scooping up their doomed prey in a mouth lined with razor-sharp teeth. As if that weren’t terrifying enough, a new study published in Current Biology finds they were pretty fast, too. A team of researchers led by paleobiologist Kiersten Formoso of Rutgers University compared two major groups of mosasaurs: the russellosaurines and mosasaurines. While both were enormous, the tail shapes of the two families differed slightly.
